flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (34.5% vs 14.9%): operating leverage

guidance.promise: Margins to bottom out in Q3, subject to no incremental rate cuts
guidance.quote: for our franchise, we should see margins bottom up out in Q3. But please do note that this is subject to no incremental rate cuts.
guidance.speaker: Puneet Sharma

guidance.promise: Grow about 300 basis points above market in medium term
guidance.quote: reiterate our aspiration in the medium term to grow about 300 basis points above market.
guidance.speaker: Subrat Mohanty

claims.claim: Total advances grew 5% QOQ and 12% YOY in Q2.
claims.quote: total advances grew 5% QOQ and 12% YOY.

claims.claim: Credit card business crossed 15 million cards in force.
claims.quote: our credit card business crossed 15 million Cards in force

claims.claim: Net interest margin stood at 3.73% annualized for the quarter.
claims.quote: Our net interest margin stood at 3.73% for the quarter, annualized.

claims.claim: GNPA at 1.46% down 11 basis points QOQ.
claims.quote: Our GNPA at 1.46% was down 11 basis points QOQ and 2 basis points YOY.

pushback.topic: One-time standard asset provision details and rationale
pushback.quote: Can you give some more color on what was the concern regarding the RBI had that you had to take this standard asset provision?

pushback.topic: Acquisition financing strategy against foreign lenders
pushback.quote: I wanted to understand how are large banks like yours, large local banks like yours, kind of pitting yourself against the already established foreign lenders in the acquisition financing space?

pushback.topic: Concerns over regulatory and compliance issues
pushback.quote: So, a week ago, I think around October 10th, the RBI's high-level committee issued a letter of caution to Axis Bank citing lapses in KYC norms related to an old account.

calls.tone: Confident and transparent, emphasizing stable asset quality and strong growth amidst regulatory changes.

guidance.promise: Maintain through cycle Net Interest Margin stance at 3.80%
guidance.quote: The Bank maintains its through cycle stance of NIMs at 3.80% (cycle measured in terms of duration, starting from the date of last rate cut).
guidance.speaker: Puneet Sharma

claims.claim: Total advances grew 4% QoQ and 14% YoY in Q3
claims.quote: Our total advances grew 4% QOQ and 14% YOY.
The Bank remains well capitalized with a CET 1 ratio of 14.50%.

claims.claim: Deposits month-end balances grew 5% QoQ and 15% YoY
claims.quote: Our Deposits growth momentum continued with month‑end balances growing 5% QoQ and 15% YoY

pushback.topic: Net Interest Margin guidance and mix effects
pushback.quote: My second, again on NIMs, is you've seen 27%, year-on-year corporate loan growth, 6% year on your retail loan growth. And of course, you highlighted disbursements are improving. But how should we think about this impacting your NIMs on mix effects?
What was surprising was the length of time you think the convergence will take..

pushback.topic: Retail asset book growth and strategy
pushback.quote: What strategy are we adopting to improve the traction there? What do you think about the market share gain opportunities that exist in the retail asset side? Because the last few quarters, it's growing in a very narrow band, if I'm not wrong, between 1% to 2% quarter on quarter?

calls.tone: Confident, resilient, and transparent regarding cycle navigation and strategic execution.

guidance.promise: Through-cycle NIM of 3.80% within 15 to 18 months from transmission of last rate cut
guidance.quote: We'll reiterate we'll get to through-cycle 3.80%, 15 to 18 months from transmission of last rate cut. That's a consistent comment we've offered.
guidance.speaker: Puneet Sharma

guidance.promise: Maintain product mix target of 70% retail and SME and 30% wholesale plus-minus 3% or 4%
guidance.quote: we expect 70-30, 70% is what is retail and SME kind of business and 30% is wholesale, plus-minus 3% or 4% here and there, and that's what we expect to maintain.
guidance.speaker: Amitabh Chaudhry

guidance.promise: Aspire for an ROE of 18 percent at the bank level
guidance.quote: At the bank level, we continue to aspire for 18% is what we would like to state.
guidance.speaker: Puneet Sharma

claims.claim: Total advances grew 6% QoQ and 19% YoY, with wholesale up 38%, SME 24% and retail 8% YoY
claims.quote: Our total advances grew 6% QOQ and 19% YOY, within which Wholesale grew 38%, SME 24% and Retail 8% on YOY basis.

claims.claim: Consolidated Q4FY26 ROA was 1.64% and ROE was 15.15%
claims.quote: Our consolidated Q4FY26 ROA was 1.64% and ROE was 15.15%

claims.claim: GNPA was at 1.23%, declining 17 bps QoQ and 5 bps YoY, with net credit cost at 0.37%
claims.quote: Our GNPA was at 1.23%, declining 17 bps QOQ and 5 bps YOY; while the Net credit cost was at 0.37%, down 13 bps YOY and 39 bps QoQ

claims.claim: Created additional one-time standard asset provision of 2,001 crores during Q4 FY26
claims.quote: the Bank created an additional one-time provision of ₹2,001 crores during the quarter.

pushback.topic: NII optimization versus loan growth and NIM timing
pushback.quote: Could you remind us if there is any day-count convention benefit in your NIMs? Secondly, if the full 25 bps rate cut from December has been passed on your EBLR book? And thirdly, if there's any residual TD repricing left on your book?

pushback.topic: Wholesale growth acceleration and RAROC sustainability
pushback.quote: At 34% year-on-year, you are growing your corporate book meaningfully faster than your peers. What opportunity do you see that others may not be seeing?

pushback.topic: Contingency provision usage conditions regarding West Asia crisis
pushback.quote: So does that mean that if indeed the situation gets worse from here on, you would actually be drawing down on these provisions this year itself because you've not drawn down on your earlier contingency provisions?

calls.tone: Cautious, conservative, and disciplined amidst global macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties.

guidance.promise: Achieve structural NIM guidance of 3.8% including the time period mentioned in the past
guidance.quote: On the direction of NIM, we have not changed our structural NIM guidance of 3.8% including the time period that we have mentioned in the past.
guidance.speaker: Subrat Mohanty

guidance.promise: Grow at industry plus 300 bps in the medium term
guidance.quote: I think what we've consistently said is we feel comfortable that we'll grow at industry plus 300 in the medium term.
guidance.speaker: Puneet Sharma

claims.claim: Total advances grew 19% YoY and 2% QoQ in Q1 FY27.
claims.quote: Our total advances grew 19% YOY and 2% QOQ, within which Wholesale grew 38%, SME 25% and Retail 8% on YOY basis.

claims.claim: Q1 FY27 Net Interest Margin (NIM) stood at 3.46%.
claims.quote: Our NIM for Q1FY27 at 3.46% is our cycle bottom.

claims.claim: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT reached 7,114 crores, up 23% YoY.
claims.quote: PAT at ₹ 7,114 cr, up 23% YOY and 1% QOQ

pushback.topic: NIM bridge and loan pricing impact
pushback.quote: Can I get some color on the 9 basis points of pricing of loans that you gave in the quarter-on-quarter NIM bridge.
And I would urge if we could go back to week day reporting.

calls.tone: Confident, transparent, and firm in strategic direction amidst margin and macro pressures.

business.what_it_does: Bank providing retail, corporate, treasury, and other financial services.

segments.name: Treasury
segments.what: Investments, trading, derivative trading and foreign exchange operations.

segments.name: Corporate/Wholesale Banking
segments.what: Corporate relationships, advisory, syndication, project appraisals and cash management.

segments.name: Retail Banking
segments.what: Lending, liability products, card services, internet and mobile banking to individuals and small businesses.

segments.name: Other Banking Business
segments.what: Para banking activities including third party product distribution.

business.mix_note: Secured portfolio accounts for 73% of total retail loan book.

credibility.line: NIM declined to 3.46% despite guidance to bottom out, and reported ROE of 13.1% misses 18% target.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue YoY growth accelerated to 17.9% in Sep 2026, aligning with management's loan growth claims.
Management predicted margins would bottom out in Q3 FY26, but Q1 FY27 NIM dropped to 3.46%.
Management aspires for 18% bank-level ROE, but reported ROE currently sits at 13.1%.
Operating cash flow turned negative at -₹8,637 crore in Mar 2026 despite reported PAT of ₹26,548 crore.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to 17.9% YoY in Sep 2026 quarter.
Sep 2026 quarterly PAT grew 37.7% YoY to ₹7,666 crore.
Total advances grew 19% YoY in Q1 FY27.
bear: Q1 FY27 NIM contracted to 3.46%, below guidance.
Mar 2026 free cash flow was negative at -₹10,797 crore.
Reported ROE of 13.1% remains below 18% aspiration.
watch: Operating cash flow recovery from -₹8,637 crore.
Retail vs wholesale loan growth balance.
